group.label: Pages on Another Theme
group.comment: For extensions not adapted to Zero yet: their pages render with another theme (typically Luma), so their RequireJS/Knockout frontend keeps working. Adapted extensions ship a compat module instead; bin/magento zero:compat:report lists which is which.

field.label: Pages
field.comment: One per line, * as wildcard, matched against "front name/controller/action" and the URL path, e.g. rma/*, amasty_rma/guest/*, blog/*. Lines starting with # are ignored.

group.label: Homepage
group.comment: The Zero homepage's sections. Left empty, each works from the catalog on its own.

field.label: Departments
field.comment: Up to four top-level categories for the department picker and "The shortlist" (one product from each). None chosen: the store root's first four active categories.

field.label: Keep Out of New Arrivals
field.comment: Products in these categories don't show in the newest-products slider.

field.label: New Arrivals "View All" Link
field.comment: The category the link opens. Empty: no link.

field.label: Show Zero's Promotional Sections
field.comment: The sections about the Zero storefront itself ("Commerce, without the drag", pillars, stats, field note), for a demo store. Keep No on a live store.

field.label: Promotional Spread Image
field.comment: A product image path under pub/media/catalog/product, e.g. /w/t/wt06-blue_main_1.jpg. Empty: a featured product's image.

field.label: Field Note Image
field.comment: As above, for the field note section.

field.label: Journal Image
field.comment: As above, for a theme's third editorial picture (a journal card). Empty: a featured product's image.

group.label: Product Badges
group.comment: Badges on product photos in lists and above the title on the product page.

field.label: New
field.comment: While today is within the product's "Set Product as New From/To" dates.

field.label: Sale -N%
field.comment: While the price is below the regular price (special price, catalog price rule, tier price), with the discount in percent.

field.label: Sticky Add to Cart
field.comment: Once the shopper scrolls past the Add to Cart button, a bar at the bottom of the screen keeps the product's name, price and the button in reach (for a product with options: "Choose options", which goes back to them).

field.label: Cache Product Cards
field.comment: Each product card of a category, search or brand page is kept in the Blocks HTML cache for up to an hour (cleaned when the product changes), so pages the page cache doesn't hold yet render faster. No turns it off.

field.label: Public at /zero/ui/
field.comment: The component library is in the admin at Content > Design > UI Components, whatever this says. Yes also opens /zero/ui/ to everyone (a demo, a design review without admin access); keep it No on a live store. Never indexed by search engines.

group.label: Sharing in Social Media
group.comment: Open Graph and Twitter card tags: the title, text and picture shown when a link to the store is shared on Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Telegram, WhatsApp, Slack and the like. Products, categories, CMS pages and blog posts describe themselves; other pages use their title and meta description.

field.label: Default Image
field.comment: For pages without a picture of their own (the home page, search, categories without an image). 1200 × 630 px works everywhere. JPG or PNG.

field.label: X (Twitter) Account
field.comment: @yourstore, shown on the card as the site's account. Optional.
